name: USD CoinVertible
oneLiner: USDCV is Societe Generale-FORGE's MiCA-regulated U.S. dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against cash and HQLA segregated at BNY Mellon.
collateral: U.S. dollar cash deposits and high-quality liquid assets held 1:1 in segregated accounts at Bank of New York Mellon (BNY), managed by independent fiduciaries and bankruptcy-remote from SG-FORGE; daily public disclosure of reserve composition

mintAuthority.summary: USDCV is issued by Societe Generale-FORGE, a MiCA-authorized e-money institution (ACPR); onboarded institutional investors subscribe by sending USD to SG-FORGE's bank account 1:1, and SG-FORGE mints and delivers the tokens against reserves segregated at BNY Mellon.

controls.label: SG-FORGE issuance backend
controls.evidence: Per SG-FORGE materials, onboarded institutional investors buy USDCV 1:1 by sending USD to SG-FORGE's bank account, after which SG-FORGE sends the minted tokens to the investor wallet; redemption mirrors this. Centralized issuer-controlled mint, no permissionless route.

review.evidence: SG-FORGE (MiCA EMI, ACPR-authorized) is the sole issuer of USDCV; per SG-FORGE materials minting is a centralized 1:1 subscription against USD sent to SG-FORGE's bank account with reserves segregated at BNY Mellon. No permissionless mint path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer-controlled mint model confirmed from SG-FORGE first-party materials; the on-chain USDCV token owner/minter admin and proxy admin were not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain USDCV token owner/minter admin and proxy admin (Ethereum/Solana) before raising to verified.
